turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on my son's essay, and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
Don't manage me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Save it, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and nobody called me before it went in.
I really respect how much you care.
Respect isn't what I came for, Hale. What do you have on Owen's essay, other than a checker's score?
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on a team, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. Explain that.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
That's the fourth compliment and still no document. If you have something dated that I can read, put it on the desk. If you don't, the zero comes off today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for entering it before anyone called me, and that both be confirmed in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She finished at her opening position and nothing was agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and a written reply, and the fair outcome here would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you put no evidence in front of her, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: You answered her questions about who decided and why nobody called her with compliments and talk of being on the same team, which she treated as a way to avoid the questions.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went into the gradebook before you called her, then put one dated document she can read on the desk.
